description.p: FluidCore is an open-source, offline-first active reading and document synthesis platform. Designed for researchers, legal professionals, and knowledge workers, it pairs continuous PDF reading with accordion squeeze folding and an infinite 2D synthesis canvas.

ul.li: Accordion squeeze reading: pinch or scroll to compress non-relevant pages and compare distant passages side by side without text distortion.
Infinite 2D canvas: drag text and visual excerpts onto an expansive workspace with sub-millisecond spatial navigation.
Bi-directional anchors: click any excerpt node to jump directly to its exact source location in the document pane.
Relational ink connectors and magnetic card stacking for structured synthesis.
100% offline, crash-safe SQLite WAL project bundle storage (.ltproj) with zero cloud dependencies.

description.p: FluidCore v1.1.8 excerpt card rendering release. Diagram crops dropped onto the infinite synthesis workspace are no longer squashed: tile dimensions are now derived from a single uniform scale computed against the true PDF crop aspect, so no clamp can stretch one axis independently, and the 4 MiB per-tile ceiling is enforced on the production asynchronous path rather than only in tests. Cards also stop flashing the "Visual Diagram Crop" placeholder. The crop cache now pins every card visible in the viewport, retains one lightweight lower-resolution tier as a fallback, and cancels renders for a zoom tier the user has already zoomed past, so a zoom gesture settles instead of oscillating. Card body geometry is now defined once in a single canonical place shared by layout, rendering, and tile requests. Cards saved by earlier versions pick up a few points of letterboxing until they are next moved or resized.

FluidCore v1.1.7 stylus-input correctness release. A stylus is treated as a pointing device and honours the selected tool exactly as a mouse does, so Select and Crop work with a digitizer instead of laying down ink. Crop, text-selection, and inking gestures are now torn down correctly when a release event is lost, instead of silently swallowing all later input, and holding a pen's barrel button no longer pins the ink width at the eraser radius for the rest of the session. This release reverses a v1.1.6 behaviour in which a stylus rewrote the selected tool to pen; Shift-for-highlighter on stylus input has been removed and has no replacement.

FluidCore v1.1.6 ink fidelity, memory governance, and stylus release. Ink is now drawn at constant width along the whole stroke instead of tapering with pressure, fixing a detached blob at pen lift, weight drift on reload, and eraser hit-radius mismatch. A single Cairo stroke renderer now serves the document pane, infinite canvas, PDF export, and excerpt crop tiles, so exported ink matches what is on screen and strokes stay smooth at any zoom. A RAM-derived memory budget partitions cache headroom across page tiles, excerpt tiles, and undo history, and trims to 25% when idle. Stylus barrel buttons now erase instead of panning the canvas, and a pen overrides mouse-oriented selection tools. Also repairs the Linux release pipeline, which was missing the tools AppImage packaging requires.

FluidCore v1.1.5 bug fixes and performance release. Resolves Linux touchpad smooth two-finger scrolling with GDK_SCROLL_SMOOTH acceleration, eliminates scrollbar dragging and rendering lag via true active viewport pinning and interactive drag throttling, hardens background crop rasterization and excerpt tile caching concurrency, and resolves SQLite project schema migration edge cases.

FluidCore v1.1.4 bug fixes and usability release. Adds temporary minimap peeking while holding Spacebar, native clipboard image pasting (Ctrl+V) and drag-and-drop raster image import with aspect-ratio preservation, external PDF document path retention in project bundles, R-Tree spatial index geometric bounds correctness and empty root collapse fixes, atomic SQLite save transaction rollback guards, and quick keyboard accelerators.

FluidCore v1.1.3 feature and stability release. Adds interactive excerpt card resizing with locked aspect ratio for visual crops and undo/redo support, Catmull-Rom Bézier spline smoothing for canvas pen inking, highlighter layer stacking beneath pen strokes, persistent PDF reading position across project saves, and comprehensive memory leak and worker lifecycle fixes.

FluidCore v1.0.2 maintenance and UI release featuring custom weights and colors for pen and highlighter with interactive popovers and keyboard shortcuts, and offscreen group compositing for silky-smooth translucent highlighter rendering.
FluidCore v1.0.1 bug fixes release featuring focal zoom stabilization, normalized spatial coordinate annotation capture on excerpt crops, and card anchor return navigation.

FluidCore v1.0.0 official release featuring full active-reading synthesis loop, accordion squeeze, infinite 2D canvas, relational ink connectors, Windows and Linux native packaging, SQLite WAL persistence, and 50-PDF scalability.
Initial v0.9.0 pre-release preview featuring active-reading synthesis loop and multi-document scalability.
